definitions.short: properly, to weigh out ; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll
definitions.usage: appoint, count, number, prepare, set, tell.
definitions.full: H4487. manah מָנָה verb count, number, reckon, assign (Late Hebrew id. ; Assyrian manû Dl HWB 416 ; Arabic assign, apportion ; Aramaic , מְנָא ); — Qal Perfect מָנָה Num 23:10 ; וּמָנִ֫יתִי Isa 65:12 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּמְנֶהֿ 1Kin 20:25 ; וַיִּמְנוּ 2Kin 12:11 ; Imperative מְנֵה 2Sam 24:1 ; Infinitive construct לִמְנוֺת Gen 13:16 4 t.; Participle מוֺנֶה Jer 33:13 ; Psa 147:4 ; — 1 count, number (compare סָפַר ) dust (grains) Gen 13:16 (J), compare יַעֲקֹב עֲפַר Num 23:10 (JE); money 2Kin 12:11 ; stars ( ׳מ לַכּוֺכָבִים מִסְמָּר ) Psa 147:4 ; flock Jer 33:13 (symbol of peace); days Psa 90:12 ; people, army 2Sam 24:1 ; 1Chr 21:1 , 17 , compare 27:24 (object omitted); 1Kin 20:25 . 2 reckon, assign, appoint לַחֶרֶב Isa 65:12 (with play on מְנִי 65:11 ). Niph`al Perfect נִמְנָה Isa 53:12 ; Imperfect יִמָּנֶה Gen 13:16 ; 1Kin 3:8 ; יִמָּנוּ 8:5 2Chr 5:6 ; Infinitive construct הִמָנוֺת Eccl 1:15 ; — 1 be counted, numbered , of descendants Gen 13:16 (J), of people 1Kin 3:8 (|| נִסְמַּר ); of sacrificial animals 8:5 2Chr 5:6 (both || id. ); indefinite Eccl 1:15 . 2 be reckoned, assigned (a place), of servant of ׳י Isa 53:12 (with מּשְׁעִים אֶת ). Pi`el (late and in poetry) (Biblical Aramaic and ᵑ7 . מַנִּי ); — Perfect מִנָּה Dan 1:10-11 , מִנּוּ Job 7:3 ; Imperfect וַיְמַן Jonah 2:1 4 t.; Imperative מַן Psa 61:8 ; appoint, ordain , food Dan 1:10 , 1:5 (followed by לְ ), officer 1:11 (followed by על ); nights of weariness ( עָמָל לֵילוֺת ) Job 7:3 (subject indefinite; followed by לְ ); in story of Jonah, object. fish Jonah 2:1 , ricinus 4:6 ; worm 4:7 , wind 4:8 (all subject b> ׳י ); object וֶאֱמֶת חֶסֶד Psa 61:8 (subject ׳י ).
